reviews.name: David R.
reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. My XK runs better than it ever has. Honest advice, fair pricing and a genuine team. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Sarah L.
reviews.text: Timing chain issue on my XK sorted quickly and professionally. No more rattling and the engine is smooth and quiet. Brilliant communication throughout.

reviews.name: Mark T.
reviews.text: Took my XK in for timing chain and injector seals. Delighted with the result. Feels like a new engine again and comes with a 12-month warranty. Top service.

reviews.name: Lisa P.
reviews.text: Clear, honest and knowledgeable team. They explained everything and kept me updated every step of the way. Wouldn't go anywhere else for my Jaguar.

reviews.name: Tom H.
reviews.text: Very happy with the rebuild on my XK. Strong performance, no issues and great fuel economy now. Worth every penny.
